If you check https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/forward_mobile/scene_forward_mobile_inc.glsl, there are 18 `uniform sampler`s and `SAMPLER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS_ANISOTROPIC_REPEAT` is 17 of them in this shader.
Likely regression from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/108219 which added multiple samplers.
If you can reproduce it on a real device and test it with a custom engine build, please try this branch to confirm it is caused by `AreaLight3D` - https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/121404
Appears to be fixed in latest 4.8.3dev
